reader.reads: Read Rank’s German text in the 1925 edition against register reading A:E124.

thesis.ru: Герой ищет окончательной защиты от преследований своего Я в убийстве двойника; это убийство есть самоубийство в безболезненной форме убийства другого Я, бессознательная иллюзия отделения дурного, заслуживающего наказания Я.
thesis.en: The hero seeks final protection from the persecutions of his ego in killing the double; this killing is suicide in the painless form of killing another ego, an unconscious illusion of splitting off an evil ego deserving punishment.

conceptions.note: The 1925 sentence supports the double and the hero’s protection from his ego; it does not name the uncanny. The reading is narrower than the register and does not establish the distinction between the 1914 and 1925 versions.
